finding: python3.11 here has no ensurepip, so a plain venv creation fails. --without-pip produces activate and python. A symlink to the venv python with no pyvenv.cfg beside it is not a venv: Python resolves to the system interpreter and pytest is missing. The offline check is right to refuse that. Both are one trial. Heat is zero.
mitigation: Retry `python -m venv --without-pip` when ensurepip is missing. Do not weaken the import check: a symlink without pyvenv.cfg is not an installed AVRONE.
